$description: Kimo editor design tokens, transcribed 1:1 from desing.pen (boards 01 Foundations, 02 Components). Source of truth for src/generated/*. Run `bun run build:tokens` after editing.

kimo.modes.convention: A mode-dependent token's $value is its light (default) value; $extensions['kimo.modes'] holds the value for every mode. Aliases to mode-dependent tokens follow the mode automatically.

primitive.$description: Mode-independent scales. Names mirror the .pen variables.

font-weight.$description: Weights used by .pen text nodes (400 is the node default when fontWeight is unset).

semantic.$description: Meaning-bearing tokens. Colors are the only mode-dependent layer.

measure.$description: Canvas measurement: snap guides, spacing and distance pills.

chip-edge.$description: Hairline edge for color chips, swatches and slider tracks.

component.$description: Component and instance identity only (ADR 0007/0011): glyphs, canvas outlines, slot outlines, override dot, component-tone selection. Never decoration.

component-soft.$description: Soft component fill: selected component/instance rows, kind pills, empty-slot fill.

type.$description: Type styles from 01 Foundations > Typography, read from each Sample node. No line-height is declared on the nodes, so none is emitted.

elevation.$description: 01 Foundations > Scales > Elevation. 'flat' has no shadow and is not a token.

component.$description: Per-component values from 02 Components, aliasing primitive/semantic tokens where the node binds a variable.
